columns.entityId: Entity identifier scoped to this dataset
columns.name: Display label
columns.value: Published quantity or explicit category; never impute null as zero
columns.period: Observation or study period, not retrieval date
columns.geographicId: ISO code or named source geography; null for abstract observations
columns.lat: Published latitude only; null when unsupported
columns.lon: Published longitude only; null when unsupported
columns.qualityScore: Source-defined qualityScore; interpretation and denominator specified in row notes and dataset metadata
columns.wineType: Source-defined wineType; interpretation and denominator specified in row notes and dataset metadata
columns.sampleDenominator: Source-defined sampleDenominator; interpretation and denominator specified in row notes and dataset metadata

denominator: 1599 red and 4898 white samples; a score-bin count divided by its wine-type total gives within-file share

geography.unit: Red and white Vinho Verde samples from northern Portugal; comparison axis is wine type and rating, not geography
geography.definition: Red and white Vinho Verde samples from northern Portugal; comparison axis is wine type and rating, not geography
geography.anchorRule: Use an explicitly non-geographic sphere or global band. No national fill, fake city locations, or inferred unobserved distribution.

time.updateCadence: Frozen research snapshot; recheck source before any update, not a live feed

sources.publisher: Cortez, Cerdeira, Almeida, Matos and Reis / UCI
sources.title: Wine Quality dataset, UCI Machine Learning Repository
sources.locator: winequality-red.csv and winequality-white.csv; quality column; repository licence

reuse.attribution: Wine Quality dataset, UCI Machine Learning Repository — Cortez, Cerdeira, Almeida, Matos and Reis / UCI
reuse.notes: Publisher explicitly identifies this article/dataset as CC BY 4.0; derived fact records, attribution retained.

coverage.population: Red and white Vinho Verde samples from northern Portugal; comparison axis is wine type and rating, not geography
coverage.included: 22 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: No vineyard/date identifiers, other wine regions, other national sensory panels or external-transfer evaluation
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: The original sample is not a random global wine sample; uneven score distribution affects training. Distinct wines can share identical analytical measurements.

transform.description: Download primary UCI ZIP; parse both semicolon-delimited CSVs; count every quality score 0–10 by wine type; preserve all 6497 numeric source records separately.
transform.validation: Sum red bins=1599, white bins=4898; total=6497. Archive SHA256 preserved; no sampling or fitted AI model.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
